title: 2x2 mesh, single 1-flit P2P 0 -> 3: T3 RTL (Verilator) parity

expected.notes: Same stimulus as V01, now executed by the T3 2D mesh RTL under Verilator (R1 trace replay). The RTL injects and ejects the exact workload, routes 0->3 in 2 hops (recovered from its latency law 7+5d), and its single-packet latency must equal the canonical completion. 2D unicast only: multicast (F1-F3) and 3D/4D are out of the qualified domain.
